name: agent-question-ui
description: The front-end of the agent-question app: the questions an agent asks a person, their answers and advices, and the transcripts behind them - one React app for the Python and the Node.js backends

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node scripts/favicon.mjs && vite build
scripts.clean: node scripts/clean.mjs node && node scripts/clean.mjs python
scripts.deploy: node scripts/deploy.mjs node && node scripts/deploy.mjs python
scripts.release: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run deploy
